title: Muxab-seq Protocol for Antibody Pooling and Cell Preparation
author: Yang Sun
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.vdme246
materials: Pool all antibodies being used in this experiment.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents and Equipment
steps.instruction: Set up the workspace and prepare necessary buffers and tubes.

substeps.instruction: Turn water bath on to 37°C.
Aliquot ~40 mL of EasySep buffer into a tube and place in the water bath until it reaches temperature.
Prepare one bucket with dry ice and one large container with regular ice.
Prepare one RT Mr. Frosty/Styrofoam box for re-cryopreservation.
Label and prepare sixteen 15-mL Falcon tubes, each containing 5 mL EasySep buffer.
Prepare one U-bottom plate with 16 wells, each containing 160 µL of flow buffer.
Prepare one FACS tube containing 450 µL of flow buffer.

steps.title: Thaw and Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Thaw cells from liquid nitrogen and transfer them into warm buffer.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve vials from liquid N2 tank and keep on dry ice until needed.
Thaw two vials at a time, unscrew aseptically, and mix gently with a P1000 (2x up and down).
Withdraw the calculated volume containing 2 million cells from each sample vial and deposit drop-wise into a 15-mL Falcon tube containing warm EasySep buffer.
Tightly close the cryovials containing the remaining cells and place them in the RT Mr. Frosty.
Move the Mr. Frosty to the -80°C freezer; transfer vials to LN2 storage the following day.

steps.title: Initial Cell Wash and DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Wash cells and treat with DNaseI to remove DNA.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the sixteen 15-mL tubes at 300 g for 5 min.
Pour off supernatant in one swift motion, dissociate the cell pellet by running the tube on the hood rack, and resuspend cells in 1 mL of EasySep buffer.
Add 1 µL of DNaseI per sample, mix by swirling, and incubate for 15 min at RT.
Prepare sixteen 15-mL tubes with 40 µm filters on top.
Transfer the DNaseI-treated sample through the 40 µm filter using a P1000.
Wash each tube and filter with an additional 4 mL of EasySep buffer, added 1 mL at a time.

steps.title: Second Wash and Sample Aliquoting
steps.instruction: Perform a second wash and aliquot samples for cell counting.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the sixteen 15-mL tubes at 300 g for 5 min.
Pour off supernatant in one swift motion, dissociate the cell pellet by running the tube on the hood rack, and resuspend cells in 200 µL of EasySep buffer.
Take 10 µL from a random set of 5 samples and add to the FACS tube with flow buffer as a control for Attune voltage settings.
Take 40 µL from every sample and place into the corresponding well of the U-bottom plate containing flow buffer.

steps.title: Cell Counting and Pooling
steps.instruction: Count cells using the Attune and pool to a specific cell number.

substeps.instruction: Load the control tube into the Attune, adjust voltages, and draw gates to count total and live cells.
Load the plate and record samples using a 100 µL recording volume and 100 µL/min flow rate; record live and total cell values in the workbook.
Withdraw the appropriate volume from each sample to achieve 1 million cells per sample.
Pool these volumes into one 15-mL tube and centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min.
Pour off supernatant in one swift motion, dissociate the cell pellet by running the tube on the hood rack, and resuspend cells in 100 µL of staining buffer.

steps.title: Antibody Staining and Washing
steps.instruction: Block cells and stain with the antibody pool.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL of FcX blocking reagent and incubate for 10 minutes on ice.
Add antibody pool to cells and incubate for 30 minutes on ice.
Add 500 µL of staining buffer, centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min, and carefully remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Wash twice with 1 mL staining buffer, centrifuging at 300 g for 5 min and removing supernatant after each wash.
Wash twice more with 1 mL staining buffer, centrifuging at 300 g for 5 min and removing supernatant after each wash.

steps.title: Final Filtration and Density Adjustment
steps.instruction: Filter cells and adjust to the final required concentration.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in a small volume (e.g., 100 µL) of washing buffer and pass the suspension through a 40 µm cell strainer (if using Flowmi, avoid pushing the tip too hard; note that ~30% volume is lost).
Take 10 µL of filtered cell suspension for counting via Countess or ViCell.
Dilute cells with washing buffer to a final density of 2.5 x 10^6 cells/mL (2500 cells/µL).
Ensure at least 5 µL of extra volume is provided for the core's cell count.

steps.title: 10x Library Preparation
steps.instruction: Deliver cells for library preparation following standard guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Bring cells to the IHG core on ice for 10x library preparation.
The core should load 20 µL per well to ensure 10k cells from each sample are loaded.
Follow the 10X Genomics 3' v2 user guide for running the controller and library preparation.
